brief: What is the latest assessed polypropylene price in Southeast Asia?

sections.title: Latest Assessed Polypropylene Price in Southeast Asia
questions: What is the most recent (latest available) assessed price for polypropylene (PP) in Southeast Asia?
Are there any gaps or caveats in the latest available price data for this series?
sections.tool_rationale: The price series for 'PP|Southeast Asia CFR|Spot' directly provides the historical monthly assessed prices, allowing retrieval of the latest available value and identification of any gaps or caveats.
sections.unanswerable_if: If the 'PP|Southeast Asia CFR|Spot' price series does not contain any non-blank price for the most recent months (i.e., if all recent months are blank), the latest price cannot be reported.

excluded.topic: Polypropylene price forecast or outlook for Southeast Asia after August 2026
excluded.reason: The price series only covers up to 2026-08, and the ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor explicitly does not publish price forecasts or outlooks.
